notes.title: Tierra now has a Quit button
notes.content:
Hi all,

Hope you are all doing well. 

I have been busy updating Tierra and have added a [b]Home button[/b] in game and a new [b]Quit button[/b] on the title menu so there is no need for keyboard combinations to get out of the game when in fullscreen.

All your progress will be magically saved automatically. Just use the Continue button when you wish to continue your game.

Hopefully this will make the game experience a little smoother.

Thanks for reading!

Chris
M9 games
